0.0: Hello, my name is #p2060000#. You must be a traveler of some sort, for you to make your way all the way down to this remote island. I live here, raising huskies. These boys are my family, my closest friends. I know I've just met you, and I apologize in advance for asking, but would you like to help me out?

yes.0: You must be a dog lover! I'm glad, because these huskies have voracious appetites, and I'm out of the supplies I brought back from El Nath. A buddy told me that the tails of the Seacles that live around here are very nutritious. Can you get #b50 #t4000161#s#k for my huskies?

no.0: I guess it was a little rude of me to ask somebody I barely know for that kind of help, but you have to understand how much healthier it is for Huskies when they eat Sea Horse Tails!

1.0: Look at that bounty from the sea! Maybe you should have been a fisherman.

yes.0: Sea Horse Tails are so good for the pups... I hope you'll come back and visit them when you've got the time.

item.0: Seacles are especially tough to handle, and if you get caught in that undertow, you're a goner. That said, I still need #b50 Sea Horse Tails#k to feed the huskies.
